mapper.select: SELECT thread_id,state FROM temporary_side_chats WHERE thread_id=#{threadId}
SELECT c.thread_id,c.state FROM temporary_side_chats c JOIN thread_lineage l ON l.child_thread_id=c.thread_id WHERE l.task_kind='SIDE_TASK' AND l.lifecycle='INDEPENDENT' ORDER BY c.thread_id

WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id,depth) AS ( SELECT thread_id,0 FROM temporary_side_chats WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id,t.depth+1 FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) SELECT thread_id FROM tree ORDER BY depth,thread_id
mapper.update: WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT thread_id FROM temporary_side_chats WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) UPDATE temporary_side_chats SET state='CLOSING' WHERE thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM tree) AND state='OPEN'
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{threadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.parent_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN ancestors a ON l.child_thread_id=a.thread_id ) SELECT c.thread_id FROM temporary_side_chats c JOIN ancestors a ON a.thread_id=c.thread_id WHERE c.state='CLOSING' ORDER BY c.thread_id LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM temporary_side_chats WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM threads WHERE threads.thread_id=temporary_side_chats.thread_id)
DELETE FROM temporary_side_chats WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND state='CLOSING'
